If sentiment is >0.5 in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% for early horizon (1–7 days) to correct upward bias.  
If sentiment is <0.5 in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 0.5–1.0% for early horizon (1–7 days) to correct downward bias.  
For mid horizon (8–15 days), if sentiment is rising (last 3 >0.5), shift forecast downward by 0.3–0.7% to align with mean reversion.  
For late horizon (16–30 days), if sentiment is negative (last 3 <0.3), apply a +0.5–1.0% correction to avoid overcorrection.  
If sentiment is flat (last 3 =0.0 or 0.33), apply no correction unless forecast deviates >1.5% from 30d moving average.  
For sentiment spikes >0.8 in last 3 days, reduce forecast by 1.0–1.5% for all horizons to prevent over-optimism.
